execute_mcp_tool_calls: execute MCP tool calls from LLM responses and return structured results with error handling
process_mcp_tools_to_openai_format: process MCP tools through filtering, deduplication and transform them to OpenAI-compatible format
create_mcp_streaming_response: create an MCP enhanced streaming response that handles LLM calls, tool execution and follow-up calls
parse_mcp_tools: parse tools and separate MCP tools with litellm_proxy from other tools in a mixed tool list
create_follow_up_input: create follow-up input with tool results in proper Responses API format for the next LLM call
